topics.name: Purpose Limitation Gate
topics.purpose: Define explicit evaluation that requested processing/use is compatible with declared data purpose before protected data leaves its current governance scope.

semantics.source_rule: Source data allowed-purpose metadata/policy is explicit.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown purpose or compatibility fails closed.
semantics.authorization_rule: Purpose gate complements, never replaces, AccessCore authorization.
semantics.derived_rule: Derived/result use is evaluated for its own purpose when materially different.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
